scientific_integrity: An exact hyperbolic one-peak argument and rational interval comparisons establish global optimality; checker supplies exact rational signs and supplementary numeric diagnostics. Claim has undergone only same-model review.
scientific_limitations: Independent Poisson founder arrivals constrained only in expected total, one-step local quorum of two and independent suitability; no long-run establishment or field calibration; isolated exact parameter example with an open robustness neighborhood, not universal phase diagram. Historical full texts of Derman et al. (1974) and Grevstad (1999) not accessible.
title: Asymmetric optimal founder effort in two identical quorum-limited habitats
